verdict.rationale: The spec says a skill is a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, and it can bundle scripts, references, and templates in a folder. The CLI writes these as plain files into `./<agent>/skills/` or `~/<agent>/skills/`, symlinked from one canonical copy, and supports 70+ agents with build-once reuse across compatible agents. Community comments praise the agent-agnostic approach and describe skills as copy-paste files, which corroborates the plain-file format. missing for 10: hands-on independent confirmation of manually copying a skill folder to a different harness and having it work unchanged.
